study.title: NIU-DASH
study.tagline: Kakak dari situs ini — dasbor dark cyber untuk 112 proyek, vanilla JS tanpa framework.
study.problem: 100+ proyek lintas domain — web, AI tools, dotfiles, GovTech — tersebar tanpa satu layar pemantauan. Portofolio butuh peta, bukan daftar panjang yang tak ada yang membaca.

approach.title: Tiga panel, satu pandangan
approach.text: Sidebar navigasi, feed kartu proyek, dan panel detail — pola dasbor productivity klasik yang terbukti enak dipakai.

approach.title: Vanilla sampai tulang
approach.text: HTML/CSS/JS murni, 100% client-side, di-hosting GitHub Pages. Tanpa build step, tanpa framework — bukti bahwa 'ringan' masih mungkin di 2026.

approach.title: Hidup dari data GitHub
approach.text: Statistik GitHub real-time plus halaman ekosistem — dasbor yang selalu segar tanpa backend.

study.outcome: v2.17 dengan 112 proyek terlacak — dan, tidak kalah penting: menjadi peta konsep yang kelak memicu penerusnya, dasbor yang sedang Anda baca ini.

en.tagline: This site's older sibling — a dark cyber dashboard for 112 projects, vanilla JS, zero frameworks.
en.problem: 100+ projects across domains — web, AI tools, dotfiles, GovTech — scattered without a single monitoring screen. A portfolio needs a map, not a long list nobody reads.

approach.title: Three panels, one view
approach.text: Navigation sidebar, project card feed, and detail panel — the classic productivity-dashboard layout that just works.

approach.title: Vanilla to the bone
approach.text: Pure HTML/CSS/JS, 100% client-side, hosted on GitHub Pages. No build step, no framework — proof that 'lightweight' is still possible in 2026.

approach.title: Alive from GitHub data
approach.text: Real-time GitHub stats plus an ecosystem page — a dashboard that stays fresh with no backend.

en.outcome: v2.17 tracking 112 projects — and, just as importantly: the concept map that later inspired its successor, the site you are reading right now.
